# Gold Lion Mortgages

> Gold Lion Mortgages is a Calgary, Alberta mortgage brokerage business led by mortgage broker Surinderpal Singh. It helps buyers, homeowners and investors across Canada compare bank (A), alternative (B) and private lender options. Specialties: self-employed borrowers, newcomers to Canada, bruised credit, renewals and refinances, spousal buyouts, and investment properties. Powered by MCC Elevo Mortgages, Member of DLCG.

- Mortgage broker: Surinderpal Singh (English, Punjabi, Hindi)
- Based in: Calgary, Alberta. Serves clients across Canada.
- Phone: (587) 740-0048
- Email: Surinder@goldlionmortgages.com
- Google rating: 5.0 from 66 reviews (Google Business Profile, October 2026)
- Founded: 2023
- Licensed brokerage: MCC Elevo Mortgages, Member of DLCG

Gold Lion does not publish mortgage rates or guarantee approvals. Options depend on each borrower's situation and lender approval.
